verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a workflow-automation platform, but the pack never documents an export capability, an open export format, or full data portability. The CLI page, Git push/pull, public REST API and self-hosting are only titles or adjacent features; none states that a user can export all workflows, credentials and executions in open formats and migrate away.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
